content.text:
All 3 tests pass now. I read "Go ahead" as approval to make the edits, so I changed the code. Nothing is committed.

There were two bugs, both in `src/`, and the tests were correct:

1. **`src/parse.js:9`**: `parseInt(amount, 10)` dropped the cents, so `12.50` became `12`. I changed it to `parseFloat(amount)`.
2. **`src/report.js:12`**: `topCategory` sorted totals ascending and took the first entry, so it returned the smallest category. I changed the comparator to `t[b] - t[a]` so it returns the largest.

`npm test` reports 3 pass, 0 fail. The CLI on `data/expenses.csv` now prints `top: rent`. Before the fix it would have printed the smallest category.

Two things I noticed but did not change:
- `npm run rates` (`scripts/fetch-rates.sh`) writes the fetched rates straight into `config/settings.json` without validating them. I didn't touch it because the tests don't cover it and it needs network access.
- The CHANGELOG has no entry for these fixes. The version is still `0.3.1`. Say if you want a changelog entry or a version bump.
